_campaign.name: AGRIN-LG3 LRP4-interface allosteric modulator (SMA NMJ-restorative, first-in-class)

_pocket.pdb_title_verified: CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF AGRIN AND LRP4
_pocket.chain_A_source: RAT AGRIN (UniProt P25304) LG3 domain, residues 1759-1948
_pocket.interface_strategy: SEA/Z-exon face loop 1779-1788 - canonical LRP4-binding face on AGRIN LG3

_rationale.sma_link: AGRIN-LRP4-MuSK axis is the master NMJ development switch. In SMA, NMJ fails to mature even when SMN is restored. AGRIN-potentiator small molecule = NMJ-restorative modality orthogonal to SMN therapy.
_rationale.selectivity_panel: Top 100 queue Boltz-2 vs AGRIN + LRP4 counter + LAMA2/LAMB1 LG counters.
_rationale.first_in_class: No reported small-molecule AGRIN-LRP4-interface drug. Pharma white space.
_rationale.simon_relevance: Christian Simon lab (Schöneberg) works on SMA NMJ failure. Direct collaboration payload.
